chapter: Suntaug Lake Inn and Duke Ellington's band
title: Blind before Duke died
summary: Whaley went blind in 1972 while still working a Georgetown show, and notes Duke died in 1974.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: He wouldn't say nothing. You'd tell him that's a great concert and then we went down here to Georgetown, I think I was blind then, I went down there with him and Mary McPartland was down there and we did a show down there.
You were blind before Duke died.
